q2.explanationZh: 第二段说 Injun Joe 杀了罗宾逊医生，还想嫁祸给穆夫，所以凶手是 Injun Joe。

evidence.quote: Injun Joe kills Dr. Robinson and tries to

q3.explanationZh: 第三段说穆夫因为谋杀案进了监狱，汤姆心里难受。最后他说出真相，是因为替穆夫感到抱歉。

evidence.quote: However, Tom feels bad when Muff goes to

q4.explanationZh: 最后一段说多亏了汤姆，穆夫被放了出来，所以A对。Joe 逃走了（B错），后来死在山洞里（C错），他不知道男孩们看见了（D错）。

evidence.quote: Thanks to him, Muff is released.

q5.explanationZh: A lion has ... 是现在完成时，要用过去分词。escape 的过去分词是 escaped。

evidence.quote: However, Injun Joe escapes through a window.

q6.explanationZh: 后面 that she wanted 是过去的内容，主句也用过去式，所以 decide 变成 decided。

evidence.quote: One day, Tom and his friend Huckleberry Finn decide to meet in the

q7.explanationZh: will be 后面接过去分词，表示被动。学生们会“被测试”，test 的过去分词是 tested。

q8.explanationZh: when she fell off 是过去的事，所以主句用过去式。hurt 的过去式还是 hurt。

evidence.quote: they are afraid that Injun Joe will hurt them.

q9.explanationZh: may never be 后面接过去分词表被动：原因可能永远不会被发现。discover 加 ed。

evidence.quote: Tom and Huckleberry later discover his box of gold.

q10.explanationZh: was 后面用过去分词表被动：士兵们发现错了以后，她被释放了。release 加 d。

evidence.quote: Thanks to him, Muff is released.

q11.explanationZh: 画线部分是做这件事的目的，用 Why 提问。原句是一般现在时，主语 Tom and his friend 是复数，所以用 do，后面动词用原形 decide。

evidence.quote: One day, Tom and his friend Huckleberry Finn

q12.explanationZh: 宾语从句要用陈述语序。原句 not to tell 变成从句，主语是 they，再用 won’t tell（不会告诉）。

evidence.quote: Huckleberry and Tom decide not to tell anyone what they have seen

q13.explanationZh: 反意疑问句：前半句是否定句（doesn’t know），后半句要用肯定形式 does he。he 指前面的主语 Injun Joe。

evidence.quote: Injun Joe doesn’t know that the boys have seen what he’s done.

q14.explanationZh: Thanks to him 的意思是“多亏了他”，可以换成 Because of him 或 Due to him，意思基本不变。

evidence.quote: Thanks to him, Muff is released.

q14.tipsZh: because of / due to 都是“因为”，后面接名词或代词。

q15.explanationZh: 先找主语 he，再用 didn’t want to get into trouble（不想惹麻烦），接 so he escaped through a window（所以他从窗户逃走了）。

evidence.quote: However, Injun Joe escapes through a window.
